learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn when to use the friendly little words 'A' and 'An'!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: In our alphabet family, there are five special friends. They are a, e, i, o, and u! We call them Vowels. They make lovely sounds.
If a word starts with a special vowel friend, we use 'An' before it. We say 'An apple' or 'An umbrella'. 'An' loves vowel sounds!
All the other letters in the alphabet are called Consonants. We use 'A' before these words. We say 'A ball' or 'A cat'. It is so easy!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 The A and An Toy Game
fun_activity.instructions: Take two bowls and put a sticky note with 'A' on one and 'An' on the other. Find small toys and put them in the right bowl while saying their names aloud!

quick_recap: ⭐ The five vowels are a, e, i, o, and u.
⭐ Use 'An' before words that start with a vowel sound, like 'An egg'.
⭐ Use 'A' before all other words, like 'A dog' or 'A book'.
